Wallpaper in Riyadh costs between SAR 64 and SAR 240 including VAT across 720 designs currently listed (October 2026). The price is per roll for every type, except American wallpaper and print wallpaper, which are priced per linear metre. A Korean roll measures 15.6 m × 106 cm and covers 16.5 m², which works out at roughly SAR 6 to 15 per square metre.

That single sentence settles most of the confusion in the Saudi wallpaper market. The quotes you collect from different suppliers do not vary because the materials are wildly different - they vary because each supplier is quoting a different unit. One shows the price of a full roll, another the price of a linear metre, a third the installed cost per square metre. Convert everything to one unit and the market turns out to be far more consistent than it looks.

The unit rule: ask about this before you ask about price

  • All wallpaper types: priced per roll. The figure on the product page is the cost of a complete roll, not a metre of it.
  • The exception - American wallpaper and print wallpaper: priced per metre. The American product page states it in so many words under its notes section: “the price is per metre”.

This matters in cash terms. Read SAR 64 on an American product and assume it buys a whole roll, and you have under-budgeted your project several times over. Read SAR 204 on a Korean product and assume it buys one metre, and you will conclude wallpaper costs more than marble. Getting the unit wrong is a bigger error than getting the price wrong.

Wallpaper price table - October 2026, VAT included

Every figure below was read directly from the store on 22 October 2026 and includes VAT:

Two notes on that table. First, the plain designs range alone holds 476 of the 720 designs, two-thirds of the catalogue; if plain is what you are after, your real range is SAR 105 to 204, not 64 to 240. Second, the SAR/m² column is calculated on the full roll area - after waste and pattern matching, add roughly SAR 2 to 3 per square metre.

Converting a roll price into a price per square metre

A Korean roll at Texa Decor measures 15.6 m × 106 cm, a gross area of 16.5 m². The area that actually ends up on the wall is smaller, because trimming and pattern matching consume some of it; the working figure is 13 to 14 m² net per roll.

So: roll price ÷ 16.5 gives the theoretical cost per square metre, and roll price ÷ 13 gives the realistic one. Plain wallpaper at SAR 105 is SAR 6.40/m² theoretical and SAR 8/m² realistic. Plain wallpaper at SAR 204 is SAR 12.40/m² theoretical and SAR 15.70/m² realistic. The realistic figure is the one to compare against other quotes - never the roll price.

How many rolls does your wall need?

  1. Count the strips for each wall separately: multiply the wall’s width in metres by 1.07 (7% cutting waste), divide by 1.06 (the roll width) and round up.
  2. Count the strips one roll gives: divide 15.6 by the wall height plus 10 cm and round down: five strips for walls up to 3 m high, four above that up to 3.8 m.
  3. Work out the rolls: divide the wall’s strips by the strips per roll and round up, then add the walls together.
  4. Leave small doors and windows in: do not deduct them. Designs needing pattern matching, such as florals and wide stripes, may need an extra roll.

Worked example - a majlis wall: 6 m wide × 3 m high: 6 × 1.07 ÷ 1.06 = 6.06, so seven strips. A roll gives five strips at that height, so you need two rolls. The wallpaper cost is SAR 210 at SAR 105 per roll, SAR 408 at SAR 204, and SAR 480 at SAR 240. Adhesive and fitting labour are additional.

Note what that means: papering an entire majlis feature wall in plain Korean stock starts at roughly SAR 200. That low figure is precisely why wallpaper remains the cheapest way to change how a room reads - considerably cheaper than interior wall cladding, which gives genuine physical relief but at several times the cost per square metre.

Which type suits which room in a Saudi villa

That last row deserves a closer look. The standard advice never to put wallpaper in a bathroom holds for ordinary paper-backed stock, but American wallpaper is multi-layer vinyl with a waterproof protective coat, made in the United States, and resistant to mould, bacteria and UV. It is the grade specified for hospitals and hotels for exactly that reason. It costs SAR 64 per metre - simultaneously the lowest headline figure and the highest unit cost in the store, a paradox the unit rule at the top of this article explains on its own.

Why you see “SAR 5 per metre” adverts

Three possibilities. The figure may be a theoretical square-metre cost derived from very cheap stock with no adhesive and no fitting. It may be conditional on an order far larger than one room needs. Or it may be lightweight paper that will not survive repeated cleaning and will not hide wall defects - in which case you pay the difference two years later when it comes off again.

Ask three questions before comparing anything: which unit is quoted (roll or metre), how many square metres the roll covers, and whether adhesive and fitting are included. Without all three, two quotes simply cannot be compared.

Frequently asked questions

How much is wallpaper per square metre in Riyadh?

Roughly SAR 6 to 15 per square metre calculated on the full roll area of 16.5 m², or SAR 8 to 18 once waste is allowed for. The figure shown on a product page is the price per roll, not per metre - except for American and print wallpaper, which are priced per metre.

How many rolls do I need for a whole room?

A 3 × 4 m room with walls up to 3 m high needs one roll per wall, which is four rolls; a 4 × 5 m room needs six. At SAR 105 per roll, four rolls come to about SAR 420.

What size is a roll of wallpaper at Texa Decor?

A Korean roll is 15.6 m long by 106 cm wide, a gross area of 16.5 m², made in Korea. The dimensions appear in the specifications section of every product page.

Can wallpaper be hung over old paint?

Yes, provided the paint is sound rather than flaking and the wall is flat and clean. Glossy oil-based paint needs light sanding so the adhesive can grip, and a cracked wall needs filling before anything goes up.

Which wallpaper is suitable for bathrooms?

Only the water-resistant American grade - multi-layer vinyl with a protective coat resistant to water, steam and mild chemicals, and resistant to mould and bacteria. It costs SAR 64 per metre and comes in ten designs.

Why do wallpaper prices range so widely, from SAR 64 to SAR 240?

Because the two ends are not the same unit. The SAR 64 is a metre of American stock; the SAR 240 is a complete Korean roll covering 16.5 m². Convert both to a square-metre basis and the range narrows sharply. Beyond that, country of origin, material and pattern type all contribute - embossed designs cost more than plain ones.

Do you deliver and fit outside Riyadh?

Delivery covers every city in the Kingdom. Installation is listed on each product page under its fitting details and is ordered separately from the wallpaper itself.

Where to start

The wallpaper collection holds 720 designs between SAR 64 and SAR 240. Within it, plain designs runs to 476 options at SAR 105 to 204 per roll, children’s wallpaper offers 40 designs at SAR 174 to 240, and water-resistant American wallpaper is SAR 64 per metre. If you want relief you can feel rather than a printed suggestion of it, look at interior wall cladding instead.

All prices were read from the store on 22 October 2026, include VAT and are subject to change; the price shown on the product page is the one that applies.
